name: Vanuatu Government Data Centre (VGDC), Port Vila
developer: Government of Vanuatu (Department of Customs, Digital Transformation / DCDT, with Australian Government support)
notes: DCDT official brochures page lists the Vanuatu Government Data Center (VGDC.pdf); DCDT events page confirms VIX is housed at the Vanuatu Government Data Centre in Port Vila; PMO Council-of-Ministers release (26 Nov 2025) indicates DCDT completed implementation of the VGDC project with Australian Government support and that Data Centres/Cloud Pilot remain State property. PeeringDB facility 2080 (Port Vila, near Meteo Department Building, 9 racks, smaller redundant DC). Government facility, not commercial colo; no MW disclosed.

name: Vanuatu Internet Exchange (VIX) at VGDC
developer: Vanuatu government with five network operators (MOU, est. 2012)
notes: DCDT states VIX was established in 2012 via MOU between government and five network operators and is housed at the Vanuatu Government Data Centre in Port Vila (Shefa). Internet-exchange infrastructure inside the government DC - interconnection asset, not a standalone commercial data center.

name: ICN1 Port Vila cable station data centre / colocation (Interchange)
notes: Interchange official pages describe ICN1 (Port Vila-Suva, Fiji, linked to Southern Cross) completed 2014; archived 2013 project page lists new data centre facilities with 22 racks incorporated within the Port Vila cable station, including customer colocation. Telecom cable station with adjacent colo space - per VU methodology registered as telecom_cable_station, not a full commercial DC.

name: Port Vila Data Centre (Australia-funded, Nakamal Agreement)
developer: Government of Vanuatu (funded by Australian Government)
notes: One of two data centres announced by Vanuatu's government (2024) for its e-commerce/digital-economy strategy, funded by Australia (combined A$120m/US$79m); Nakamal Agreement between Australia and Vanuatu signed 29 Jun 2026 (ABC News). Located in Port Vila; details sparse, no public MW; status announced/planned - no construction evidence.

name: Vanuatu Data Park (local hosting service)
notes: Small local data centre/web-hosting service; primary evidence is a YouTube channel titled 'Vanuatu Data Centre and web hosting'. Location (likely Port Vila) and scale unverified; no public MW capacity.

name: Santo Data Centre (Australia-funded, Nakamal Agreement)
developer: Government of Vanuatu (funded by Australian Government)
notes: Second of two data centres funded by Australia under the Nakamal Agreement (signed 29 Jun 2026), located on the island of Santo (Espiritu Santo, Sanma province). Vanuatu government announced the pair in 2024 as part of its digital-economy strategy; details sparse, no public MW; status announced/planned.
